about: The code and fonts from others that Phazite is built with, in its app and its helper, each with the notice its licence asks to go with every copy. CMake copies each one's sources, joined, into licenses/<file> next to the app and writes NOTICES.txt from this list (cmake/PhaziteNotices.cmake); the About box lists them (ui/shell/AboutPanel.h); docs/third-party.md says more of each. An entry with platforms is in those builds only.
